active_phase.immediate_objective: Close UIC-002 (RADIUS_OUTSIDE_ENUM) and UIC-010 (SEMANTIC_PILL_RADIUS_MISUSE) across every inventoried application screen in ONE property-based batch, holding UIC-007 (PILL_RADIUS_ON_BUTTON) at zero. RESULT: UIC-002 93 blocking -> 0 blocking / 0 coverage; UIC-010 16 blocking + 2 coverage -> 0 / 0; UIC-007 0 throughout; UIC-001 stays 0. Every other rule is byte-identical to the entry baseline and coverage is unchanged at FULL 28 / PARTIAL 39 / UNSUPPORTED 0, so the pass has no incidental decrease to explain. THE PASS HARD-STOPPED ONCE, CORRECTLY, AFTER THE TECHNICAL REMEDIATION: the mandatory test-coupling manifest had been built from a radius-construct search and missed four cache-bust-coupled tests that the full sweep then failed. The executor stopped with nothing committed and returned the exact set; the architect issued the A1 delta amendment and the same material phase resumed. A1 ruled four things. (1) The four cache-coupled tests are classification D and were retargeted asset-by-asset, preserving every single-load, ordering, geometry and module-presence assertion; a dedicated `git grep "?v=" -- tests` sweep, mandated by A1 and run before editing, surfaced a fifth (tests/painel-screen.smoke.js) pinned to painel.js, which A1 itself newly authorized, and it was corrected the same way. (2) Six count and classification badges ARE semantic pills and must keep var(--rv-radius-pill); because the js-screen front-end populated attrMap with nothing, their role was unprovable and D6.1 would have forced them to ordinary geometry. The authorized correction transports a statically declared data-ui-pill attribute into attrMap, exactly as the .dc.html front-end has always done from real markup, evaluates no dynamic expression, infers no other role, leaves isSemanticPill() and every threshold, enum and severity unchanged, and raises the detector to 1.0.3. Measured against the same tree with the old front-end: six UIC-010 findings removed, none added, no other rule touched, coverage identical. (3) The 19 detector-invisible radius literals inside the original 26 files stay in this pass. (4) js/screens/painel.js, js/screens/op-distribuicao-ui.js and js/screens/ordem-compra-render.js were added to the path boundary; a full 66-screen source scan proved they held every remaining out-of-enum radius and that no other file did. 135 sites were treated in total: 62 ordinary surfaces and controls to var(--rv-radius), 8 semantic pills to var(--rv-radius-pill) with a role marker, 53 true circles to var(--rv-radius-pill) with equal declared width and height, 21 partial-corner or child geometries moved to the owning parent with overflow clipping. No token was added or changed, no colour moved, no enum widened, no waiver or suppression exists, and the accepted 4px enum literals and the --rv-radius-card/--rv-radius-control aliases (UIC-009 debt) were left alone. Six screens moved deviation -> unaudited; none regressed. Disclosed and NOT in scope: 97 Tailwind radius utility classes across 13 screens still render out-of-enum radii, rounded-full at >= 20px; they are utility classes rather than CSS radius declarations, the same class of residue pass 1 was accepted with for colour, and closing them needs a separate authorization.
